description: Land Acquisition - Kondavil, Nallur D/S Division, Jaffna District - Sandilippai, Walikamam South West Saudilippai D/S Division, Jaffna District - Correction Paper to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2253/19 of 10.11.2021
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for taking possession of land parcels, detailed descriptions of land boundaries and extents, and corrections to previous land acquisition notices. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
